item.title: Rockstar Issues New Official Statement on the GTA 6 Leaks
item.description:
Rockstar Games has spent years developing Grand Theft Auto 6 , with its return to Vice City bringing new characters, a sprawling open world, and countless details that players have been eager to see. However, not every part of that process was meant for public consumption. Back in 2022, before Rockstar officially revealed GTA 6 , unfinished gameplay footage leaked online and gave fans an unexpected look at early versions of environments, animations, and mechanics that were still being refined.

In 2022, a hacker gained access to Rockstar Games' Slack channels through a phishing attack and published tons of still-in-development GTA 6 gameplay. It wasn't ready to be shown, and that led to legal troubles for the alleged GTA 6 hacker, tons of discourse online as folks hated on the gameplay, and many other issues. Unfortunately, that wasn't even the last leak. More recently, an individual or group has published small snippets of gameplay from more recent builds (including a recent leak of Lucia's customization in GTA 6 ), although that appears to be slowing down.

GTA 6 Could Be Coming to PC Much Sooner Than Expected, Says Report

As the official launch of GTA 6 approaches, PC fans got some exciting news that points towards a port of the game releasing sooner than expected.

By Drew Swanson

GTA 6 Leaks Are "Dirty Washing," Says Dev

For Rockstar art director Aaron Garbut, as revealed in Bloomberg's recent expose on the game's development, the 2022 Grand Theft Auto 6 leak was about more than having unfinished footage circulate online. Reflecting on the incident, Garbut described the experience as feeling like somebody was “wading through your dirty washing.” He explained that seeing the work was like having someone inside your head, exposing material that nobody outside the development team was ever supposed to see. Garbut ultimately called the experience “really weirdly invasive,” highlighting the personal toll of having years of creative work exposed without warning. In his own words,

“It feels like somebody’s wading through your dirty washing. It’s like they’re inside your head. You see your early work out there. Nobody’s ever supposed to see that. It’s really weirdly invasive, and so it’s quite hard to deal with on an emotional level.”

Find the odd one out before the timer hits zero.

Round 1

Which one doesn't belong?

0 / 10
10.0 s

Results

0/5

Best: 0/5

—

More Games

The reaction helps explain why the leak was so difficult for Rockstar to manage. Players were suddenly judging GTA 6 through development footage that was never intended to represent the final game, with some criticizing its unfinished animations, visuals, and overall presentation. Of course, none of that mattered when Grand Theft Auto 6 's first trailer was released, but it colored the weeks and months leading up to that event badly.

The 2022 Grand Theft Auto 6 leak remains a reminder that major game reveals involve more than building anticipation. Developers spend years refining an experience, and a sudden breach can strip away the context that makes early work understandable. Garbut's comments offer a rare glimpse into the human side of that situation and certainly speak for several other developers at Rockstar as well.

Rockstar Issues New Official Statement on the GTA 6 Leaks
GTA 6 Leaker Says 'The Leaks Stop Here' After Crypto Coin Crashes
GTA 6 Officially Has an Advanced Sweat System
God of War Laufey's Collector Box Makes GTA 6's Missing Game a Bigger Problem

Now, GTA 6 's release date is just a month away. Most folks have forgotten about the 2022 leaks, and the more recent ones will end one way or another. Rockstar put a definitive end to 2022's discourse and will prove it come November 2026, but the problem remains that September 2022 was not November 2026.

item.title: 8 Best Open-World RPGs You Need To Play In Fall 2026
item.description:
As we head into the final few months of 2026 , a lot of people are still on the hunt for a meaty open-world RPG to keep them entertained on those cold Autumn nights. Thankfully, many games in the genre capture that Fall feel and have recently received, or will soon receive, a major expansion to make their worlds even more exciting.

Although it may seem like the year is over, 2026 still has plenty of upcoming gaming drops across a range of settings and stories, from post-apocalyptic lands to fantasy epics. And, because of how many hours you can pour into these games, Fall 2026 is the perfect time to jump in and get grinding before those adventures get a whole lot bigger.

6 Underrated Open-World RPGs That Are Considered Masterpieces

These lesser-known open-world RPGs deserve more attention, and those who played them probably agree they’re true gems of the genre.

By Vlad Mazanko

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt

What More Could You Want?

  • Remaster update for the entire game released last month.
  • Upcoming third DLC in 2027.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt sets the standard for open-world storytelling, gifting you with hundreds of unique quests and characters that all have as much life as the next. The game has been out for over a decade now, but thanks to a recent major remaster, many players may want to hop back in and revisit those incredible stories in a whole new light.

The combat has been updated, the visuals improved, and a whole host of other QoL additions have transformed the game into the perfect RPG, even more so than it already was. With a brand-new DLC on the horizon and a sequel to follow, I would highly recommend brushing up on your Witcher lore before turning the page to those new chapters.

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen

Expanding To The North

  • A whole new region to explore.
  • Additional challenges and items.

Dragon’s Dogma 2 offers one of the genre’s most unpredictable open worlds, where you and your AI-controlled pawns can tackle griffins, ogres, and much more in fights that can collapse into chaos in seconds. Much of the original game's DNA remains present, but the sequel improves many its features, from the vocations to the transformative nature of the world around you.

The Witcher 3 Is a Great Story Trapped Inside an Overrated RPG

The Witcher 3 has earned its place among gaming's greatest titles, but some aspects of the beloved RPG deserve a closer look.

By Nikol Nikolova

As if that wasn't enough, Dark Arisen has just arrived, a massive DLC adding a new frozen region with its own stories and quests to discover and enemies to take down, along with a dozen new dungeons to the base game. If you are yet to become an Arisen yourself, why not grab the bundle now and see why many people consider Dragon's Dogma 2 one of the best RPGs of this generation.

Crimson Desert

Better Than Ever

  • Virtually all launch issues have now been fixed.
  • New major story DLC with naval exploration.

Crimson Desert launched to fairly lukewarm reviews, with a lot of early impressions riddled with complaints despite all the great strides the game takes. However, in the months after its launch, the game has been patched and updated to fix a lot of the mechanical and pacing issues, turning it into the true open-world sandbox the developer promised from the start.

On top of the base game improvements, the first story expansion is also just around the corner, which continues the narrative past the ending and adds some naval exploration mechanics to boot. There's a reason this game sold upwards of five million copies in its first month, and today you get to experience the best version of Crimson Desert virtually devoid of those initial problems.

Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2

Embodying The Harvest

  • Over 100 hours of deep RPG content.
  • A perfect autumn-feeling world.

Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 was many people's Game of the Year in 2025, and it is easy to see why. Its world is obsessed with authenticity, and it really feels as though you are being transported to the 15th century and thrust into the shoes of an unlikely hero with a heart of gold.

The scale is almost doubled from the first game, and you can easily sink over 100 hours into exploring the lush forests and bustling towns of Bohemia, all coated in a warm, Autumn feel. It’s a slow, immersive RPG built for evenings when it’s too cold to go outside. KCD2 gives you all the warmth you could ever need thanks to Henry and his courage to fight for what he sees as right.

Fallout 76

Adding Frights To The Wasteland

  • Multi-week seasonal slasher event.
  • Halloween-style expansion on top of existing lore.

Fallout 76 has come a long way since its troubled beginnings, but is now one of the premier modern Fallout games. You and a group of friends can all explore and conquer the Wasteland, investigating wreckage and carving out your own slice of the surface in the wake of nuclear war.

For all you Halloween fanatics, the recent Slasher update was built for spooky season, introducing a murderous lunatic and his fanatics who have infested the map. It is up to you to piece together clues over the coming weeks to put a stop to their antics. Looking further ahead, more expansions are on the way, and if you're going in blind this many years after launch, rest assured: you will have no shortage of content to enjoy both alone or as a group.

The Elder Scrolls Online

Return To Tamriel

  • Free access to past DLCs coming soon.
  • More Skyrim content planned for 2027.

The Elder Scrolls Online has continued to grow alongside so many other MMORPGs and, in the drought of mainline Bethesda releases, serves as the ideal place to scratch that fantasy itch. Since moving to a seasonal model in April 2026, the studio has made all new content free and rolled several previously paid expansions into the base game, lowering the barrier to entry for newcomers and making it a much more accessible MMO.

6 Best Open-World RPGs You Can't Stop Playing

Many open-world RPGs are notorious for keeping you playing far longer than planned, and these titles are definitely among the biggest culprits.

1
By Vlad Mazanko

The train of DLCs doesn't stop there, as the Greymoor and Wolfhunter expansions will also be joining the base game for free, and Season Two: Echoes of Skyrim begins shortly after. As a casual MMO fan, I would argue that The Elder Scrolls Online is among the best ones around today, and a great place to kick back this fall if you are on the lookout for something to really sink your teeth into.

Final Fantasy 7 Remake Trilolgy

Experience The Rebirth

  • Remake and Rebirth revive the iconic story.
  • The third game, Revelation, is releasing in early 2027.

Final Fantasy 7 re-entered the limelight back in 2022 with Final Fantasy 7 Remake , reimagining Midgar as a dense, cinematic adventure. Rebirth expands the story into a vast open world filled with countless minigames, quests, and a boatload of action-packed battles that breathe new life into some of the franchise's most iconic characters.

We already knew that the remakes were intended as a trilogy, and in 2027, the grand finale arrives with Revelation , featuring returning favorites like Cid and Vincent as playable characters. There's a lot of story to get through and a lot of time to do it, so if Final Fantasy 7 was ever on your radar, I think now's the time to start powering through it.

Monster Hunter Wilds

Hunting The Biggest Beasts

  • Ascendance expansion is dropping in 2027.
  • Continuous updates and fixes were added over the last year.

Monster Hunter Wilds widens the playing field with an expansive open world packed with creatures of all shapes and sizes for you to hunt down. Unlike a lot of other RPGs, the game makes each fight feel like a cinematic battle of wits and stamina, adding more strategic elements to the combat and requiring a lot more thought from your party for tougher hunts.

A lot of the press around the game centered on performance issues at launch, but those problems have been slowly ironed out via regular updates to improve the existing gameplay experience. But that doesn't mean there aren't more exciting adventures on the way. In 2027, we will be getting our hands on Ascendance , a new expansion that will take you high above the ground and into the gorgeous floating islands of Skybound Eyrie for those who are ready to conquer their fear of heights.

item.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Haunted Well Puzzle Guide
item.description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley has a creepy well hiding a little puzzle this Halloween. The Haunted Well is one of the Trick or Treat event rewards, but getting your hands on it means solving a candy puzzle first. If this puzzle has you scratching your head, don’t worry. Here’s how to solve the Haunted Well puzzle in DDV .

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Trick or Treat Event Guide (2026)

Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Trick or Treat event is back with Halloween duties and rewards. Here’s how to complete them all.

By Umama Ali

How to Start the Haunted Well Puzzle in Dreamlight Valley

Red Chest Location for the Haunted Well in DDV

The first thing you need to do is go to the Plaza biome and find the red chest. Opening it will reveal a memory containing clues for the Haunted Well puzzle.

Its location may be different in your game, but the screenshot above shows where I found mine.

How to Solve the Haunted Well Puzzle in DDV

The Memory Shard shows three equations using green, red, and purple candies. You need to figure out the value of each candy to solve the puzzle.

Equation One:

  • Green Candy + Green Candy + Green Candy = 45

Divide 45 by 3, and you get 15. This means each Green Candy is worth 15.

Equation Two:

  • Green Candy + Red Candy + Red Candy = 35.

You already know that Green Candy is worth 15, so subtract that from 35. This leaves 20, which you divide by 2 to get 10. This means that each Red Candy is worth 10.

Equation Three:

  • Green Candy - Purple Candy = Red Candy

Using the values from the first two equations, this becomes 15 − Purple Candy = 10. This means Purple Candy is worth 5.

The final values are 15 for Green Candy, 10 for Red Candy, and 5 for Purple Candy. Keep these numbers in mind.

Haunted Well Location in Dreamlight Valley

Once you have solved the equations, fast travel to the Forest of Valor to find the Haunted Well. The screenshot above shows where I found the Haunted Well in the biome, but its location may be different in your game. Interact with it and deposit the candies in this order:

  • 15 Green Candies
  • 10 Red Candies
  • 5 Purple Candies

After depositing all the candies, you’ll unlock the Haunted Well. Open the Furniture menu to place it wherever you like in your valley.

You can also purchase additional Haunted Wells from Scrooge’s Store after completing the puzzle.

item.title: GTA 6 Leaker Says 'The Leaks Stop Here' After Crypto Coin Crashes
item.description:
The Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek appears to be calling it quits after their crypto token crashed. However, there is still a possibility that the GTA 6 leaker may end up spoiling the game for everyone.

Cyberleek initially claimed that the leaks were being put onto the internet due to their frustrations with Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar, and even Sony. In particular, they expressed anger at digital pre-orders, GTA 6 having DLC-only content, and at the PS5 ending physical copies for new games. However, some have been suspicious of their alleged reasoning, as the leaker has also been encouraging fans to buy their cryptocurrency token, leading some to believe they're a scammer and/or don't actually have a copy of the game at all.

Rockstar Officially Addresses GTA 6 Story and Gameplay Leaks

Rockstar Games releases its first official response to GTA 6's massive story and gameplay leaks.

By Daniel Morris

GTA Leaker Says It's Over, With a Catch

GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek made an official statement on October 14, indicating that the leaks were coming to an end. Following an initial leak in August, Cyberleek began pushing a crypto token, with more leaks promised if the cryptocurrency reached certain thresholds. The latest claim was that they would release a playable build onto the internet if the crypto token reached a value of $30 million, but the token subsequently crashed. Cyberleek claims that the crypto push wasn't a "rugpull" and that the cryptocurrency was always encouraged as a method of donating to the leaker, not as an actual investment. The crypto token, which peaked at $0.03 a piece, has since plummeted to $0.0015 as of publication time.

With the game just shy of a month from its release, Cyberleek claims that they won't spoil the ending for players, unless they're "removed," presumably referring to being arrested. In such a case, they claim to have a dead man's switch that will dump the story spoiler leaks onto the internet, so players may want to remain wary of spoilers until the game's official release. Even if the so-called dead man's switch is legitimate, it won't do much good once the game is officially out. However, efforts to ascertain who the leaker is and to bring them to justice will undoubtedly continue long past that point, providing that they're not caught prior to the game's launch.

item.title: Riot Games Announces Upcoming Change to League Classic
item.description:
League of Legends developer Riot Games confirmed that the popular League Classic mode would end its current run once Season 3 of 2026 concludes due to most players going back to other game modes. In short, Classic is an official League of Legends game mode that recreates the gameplay and character balance from the hit MOBA title's earlier years.

League of Legends Classic was first introduced on July 29 alongside Patch 26.15. Compared to standard gameplay modes, League Classic focuses on strategy over action. Along with a limited selection of playable Champions, such as Vayne and Ezreal, Classic also has user interface elements that some of the game's older fans may recognize. Although game modes such as Arena and All Random All Mid (ARAM) exist in modern League of Legends , the only mode available in League Classic is Summoner's Rift, the game's iconic 5v5 map.

League of Legends Is Finally Adding a Feature Players Have Wanted for 17 Years

Riot Games unveils a highly-requested feature that will soon be added to League of Legends for the first time in the game's 17-year history.

By James Ratcliff

League Classic's Days Are Numbered

Despite the initial popularity of League Classic , Riot Games stated that its days are numbered. According to a developers' post by Paul "Pabro" Bellezza and Andrei "Meddler" van Roon, League of Legends Classic will be available in its current form until Season 3 of 2026 concludes on January 6, 2027, when it will become unavailable as a full game mode. However, Riot Games stated that Classic could be brought back as a future event mode with some adjustments and additions in response to feedback. Additionally, all Classic-specific cosmetic content that was purchased will be refunded. The League Classic Pass in Patch 26.21 will be changed to a free track, meaning players can unlock classic player icons by clearing missions and earning Classic Pass Coins in the process.

More Games

Starting with Patch 26.21 on October 21, the only items that can be bought at the Classic Store are runes, rune pages, and champions. Champions already acquired in modern League of Legends can be played in Classic at no additional cost. League Classic will also transition to windowed queues in several game regions that saw decreased player participation, such as Korea, Oceania, and Latin America. Once Patch 26.21 arrives, the window will be open from 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM server time Monday through Friday, and 10:00 to 1:00 AM server time on weekends. Additionally, League Classic will only be available in Japan and the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region via custom matches.
